caption:
Chilli Cheese Omlette 
Lazy girl breakfast | high protein 
Nutrition: 
C: 23 | F: 17 | P: 22
Calories: 346 per serve without bread 
Serves 1

Ingredients
knobb of butter
2 eggs
1 tbsp milk
1/2 onion, finely chopped
2 green chillies, finely chopped 
1/2 green capsicum, small cubes 
20 grams cheese, grated or sliced
salt + pepper to taste 

Method 
add butter to the pan 
add in onions and chillies and the green capsicum with some salt and pepper to taste
in another bowl, add in the eggs + 1 tbsp milk + salt & pepper and whisk together
add the mix to the pan and allow to cook then flip it over
add the cheese and fold it
serve with some buttered toast or enjoy as is :)
